1. (Currently Amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product __on a computing device.__

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user __from a user information medium.__ 

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the __user's role or relationship to the product.__ 

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for __the user of the product.__ 

27. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to receive __and process__ a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the computing device further configured to communicate with a network.
